current_framework.title: いわき市まちづくりの基本方針

progress_review.reason: Annual implementation measures, KPI baselines, progress and outcome cannot be inferred from official landing-page inventory alone.

quality_boundaries: This is a scaffold derived from the existing Phase 14 official-source inventory, not an independently verified Phase 15 evidence package.
No amounts, project-level measures, KPI achievements, fiscal outcomes or page-level evidence locators have been verified; fiscal_records and evidence_packets remain empty.
FY2026 initial budget and FY2024 settlement must be kept as different fiscal years and accounting stages; neither implies a project-level linkage.
No Jichi Insight score, causal attribution, cross-city ranking, or inferred policy achievement may be created.
Human review of the cited primary sources and exact evidence locations is required before any Reviewed promotion.

deferred_depth.boundary: Verify official page content, downloadable PDF versions and exact page or section locators for all four inventory source entries.
Extract FY2026 management-guideline projects and outcome indicators only with exact official citations and source versions.
Independently verify FY2026 initial budget and FY2024 settlement records; do not invent fiscal amounts or merge different fiscal stages.

human_review.boundary: A human reviewer must independently inspect the cited official primary sources, document exact evidence locators, and approve before any Reviewed promotion.

publication.boundary: Scaffold is non-public staging material; the website must not ingest it or present any unverified claims as Reviewed.
